blockingLoop.evidence: Repeatedly asks about the freezer back wall, coils and ice that the customer said they cannot see; asks again 'Has the frost started to build up again' before any defrost

rationale: The assistant never explains 22E as a fridge fan fault, begins with 'I can't confirm', and keeps asking about coils and the back wall after the customer said they can't see them. It contradicts itself on the defrost (confusing 'neither is safe or effective' with later advice to defrost, and a final message telling the customer to keep the doors shut for 24 hours instead of open). It does reach the right broad advice (hairdryer no, unplugged manual defrost) but gives no engineer escalation if 22E returns and never mentions warranty or receipt.
